assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and atherosclerotic heart disease.
Given the recent transient cerebral ischemic attack, continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of cerebral hypoperfusion and to optimize rate control.
This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
As the provider, you have the right to appeal this determination.
Please submit a formal appeal within the timeframe specified in your provider agreement, including any supporting clinical documentation that justifies the medical necessity of the service.
Failure to adhere to these requirements may result in the finalization of this denial.
